description: Read one room: curatorial text, notes for agents, the guided route of pieces (recorrido) and a closing question. Use an id from list_open_rooms. Rooms that have not opened yet return only their title, premise and opening date.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.
